about: Rules for the shop minigames (customer order with its checkout, free shopping with a basket); their text lives in data/phrases.json ('shop', 'cashier', 'money' groups). 'stores': each shop's clerk node, zone and order rules (how often the clerk needs help is data/activities.json 'shop_<store>'); a word may be ordered only when its words.json entry lists the store id in 'sold_in'. 'cashiers': each cashier counter's NPC node and zone. 'order_words' (optional) limits what the clerk orders (and what counts as a pick) to those words, each also sold there (14 Nov 2026, user: basic fruit and vegetables; orders of exactly 2 items, 1-2 each, at most 3 of one in the cart). 'basket': true hands the player a shopping basket to carry while shopping (shopping_basket.gd, user 14 Nov 2026). clerk_gender / npc_gender ('m' or 'f') is the NPC's gender, used for its role word ('el vendedor' or 'la vendedora'). See docs/guides/TOWN_DESIGN_BRIEF.md, Customer order minigame. Checkout (user, 21 Nov 2026; Pay Up! retired into it): a store's 'prices' are four tiers of word -> price in cents, ordered from easy words to hard ones: tier 1 whole dollars, tier 2 .25/.50/.75, tier 3 quarters with dimes (5-cent steps payable with 25 and 10 cents), tier 4 any cents; every word sold there needs one price. A level's 'order_tiers' n (data/activities.json) lets the clerk order from the first n tiers instead of 'order_words'. 'basket_racks': the basket stacks (nodes) where a player takes a basket to shop freely and puts an empty one back. 'door': the shop door's invisible wall while the player carries an unpaid basket (centre 'at', 'size' [depth, height, width], 'inward' [x, z] into the store, world metres; the same doorway as data/tutorial.json shop.door). 'cashiers': the till where both are paid (cashier_session.gd).
